summary_md: **Konstantinos Gkolias ([@con_golias](https://x.com/con_golias/status/2116558183669878800))** measured 6,000 public dotfiles repos from 2015 to 2026 and found AI coding-agent config (.claude/, .codex/config.toml, opencode.json, AGENTS.md) went from 1 in 2,414 active repos in 2024 to 29.8% in 2026, the fastest shift in a decade, complementing Zarzycki's AGENTS.md census ([data and method](https://github.com/con-golias/workings/tree/main/2026-11-01-dotfiles-agents), [arXiv 2610.31715](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31715)).

referenced_urls.title: What Open-Source Projects Tell Their Coding Agents: A Census of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md

relevance: Adoption data on user-level agent config.
